abstract: A 48-year-old male who presented with an enlarged right scrotum was diagnosed with malignant transformation of testicular teratoma. Physical examination revealed a right scrotal mass of hard consistency with no inguinal lymphadenopathy. Since prepuberty, his right testis had been larger than the left one, with no pain or tenderness. Computed tomography and bone scan revealed retroperitoneal lymphadenopathy and multiple bone metastases. Right orchiectomy was performed immediately, and a pathological examination revealed a mature teratoma associated with adenocarcinoma, showing signet ring cell differentiation. Cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy was administered; however, the metastatic lesions progressed, and the patient succumbed to the disease after 15 months. Only a few cases of primary malignant transformation of teratoma in the testis have been reported, and this is the first case report of primary malignant transformation of teratoma in the testis with signet ring cell-type differentiation.
abstract_ja: 48歳男性が右陰嚢の腫大を主訴に受診した。触診では硬度のある右陰嚢内腫瘤が認められ、鼠径リンパ節腫脹はなかった。思春期前から右精巣が左より大きかったが、疼痛や圧痛はなかった。CTおよび骨シンチグラフィでは後腹膜リンパ節腫大と多発骨転移が認められた。直ちに右精巣摘除術が施行され、病理組織学的に成熟奇形腫に腺癌を伴い、印環細胞への分化を示すことが確認された。シスプラチンを基にした併用化学療法が行われたが、転移病巣は進行し、患者は15か月後に死亡した。精巣奇形腫の原発性悪性転化の報告例は少なく、本症例は印環細胞への分化を伴う精巣奇形腫の原発性悪性転化の初めての症例報告である。
